name: USDA FSIS — Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart
used_for: Official minimum internal cooking temperatures: poultry 165 F (73.9 C); ground meats 160 F (71.1 C); beef, pork, veal and lamb steaks, chops and roasts 145 F (62.8 C) with a 3-minute rest; fish and shellfish 145 F (62.8 C); leftovers and casseroles 165 F (73.9 C). Any doneness figure on this site must defer to this chart.
